question: Which diverse classes of beings are included among those associated with this teaching?
premises: Kinnaras, yakshas, and asuras are mentioned
Ascetics rich in austerity are included
inference: Various celestial, semi-divine, and ascetic beings are included in this context.
uncertainties: garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakshas, asuras, and ascetics rich in austerity are included.
